prompt:
CONCEPT: a female personification of Zhang Zhao (장소), a court official of Eastern Wu in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms — the senior minister whose blunt advice often angered Sun Quan. Reimagined as a woman; her costume, ornaments, colours and bearing carry her famous deeds and temperament. This is a character design, not a historical portrait.
STYLE: Premium Korean MMORPG promotional character render — an in-engine 3D character model with hand-painted textures, not flat cel shading and not a 2D anime illustration: semi-realistic volumetric forms, porcelain skin with a soft subsurface glow and glossy specular highlights, a small refined face with delicate realistic-anime features, long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure — soft, rounded volume at bust, hips and thighs in the body type SILHOUETTE names; never thin, flat or boyishly straight. Polished metal, silk and gems catch sharp highlights. Extremely intricate ornamented costume — filigree metalwork, jewel inlays, layered translucent fabrics and fine embroidery. Character-select-screen lighting: strong rim light, soft key light on the face, drifting light particles, atmospheric depth with a softly blurred background. Luxurious, high-detail finish.
TRAITS of Zhang Zhao to carry in her design and the scene: stern integrity, heavy scholar's robes, a frown.
FACTION — Eastern Wu. Palette: crimson red, gold, river teal, black lacquer.
AGE: late thirties — a glamorous, alluring mature beauty in her prime: confident, sensual poise, a knowing gaze and a ripe, womanly figure; smooth, radiant skin with at most the faintest lines at the eye corners; never old, tired, gaunt or matronly — still the small, soft chin and soft contours.
SILHOUETTE: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist build; a single thick braid over one shoulder with hair swept back off the forehead; vivid magenta hair.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a mature, poised woman; fair skin; heart-shaped face; moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes — wide almond eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; low heavy brows; broad soft nose; small bow lips; navy-blue eyes; a bare, makeup-free face.
WORLD — MECHA: year 2190, the Wu carrier fleet in orbit above an ocean world: crimson starships and carriers, a glowing nebula, the planet's blue oceans and storm clouds below, neon running lights on the hulls. MECHA DESIGN: she is a female mecha personification, built as a support and logistics mecha frame — lighter plating, data panels and shield units, utility sub-arms; plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry her faction palette and the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; her signature item is rebuilt as part of the frame or as a mecha armament. Mecha plating covers her frame except where EXPOSURE opens it — no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates; any cape is rigid armored binder plates. Her face and hair stay human. The setting is far-future science fiction — space stations, starships, planets, nebulae and high-tech structures; no traditional East-Asian architecture, no pagodas, tiled roofs or stone lanterns. FACTION FRAME: crimson and black lacquer plating with gold edges, streamlined naval hull shapes and fin binders, hydrojet thrusters, flame-orange glow lines.
MECHA SILHOUETTE: a large equipment unit worn on the back (tanks, a cannon barrel or antennae) rising above her head as the main shape, with medium body armor. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely.
MOOD: sleek sci-fi key art — clean reflective plates, glowing light lines, hovering light particles and a soft bloom.
EXPOSURE (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates, and bare upper thighs between the hip armor and thigh-high leg plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
SIGNATURE ITEM: a bamboo tablet of remonstrance — rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour and no wood, silk tassels or forged-bronze fittings. She holds or carries it, drawn at full scale. It is one whole object drawn once: a long weapon (spear, glaive, halberd, staff, bow) keeps a single straight, unbroken shaft from butt to head with exactly one head or blade, held in front of or beside her body — never passing behind her head or shoulders, never broken, bent, split in two by her body or arm, or duplicated; if the frame cuts it, it leaves the frame as one straight line.
EXPRESSION: a level, steady look, mouth closed. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no horse or other creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.

observations: 짙은 마젠타·와인색 옆 땋은 머리·밝은 피부, 진홍·검정·금색 하드서피스 장갑.
대형 등 장비가 머리 위로 솟고 전신·양 부츠·우주 항모·해양 행성·폭풍·성운 확인.
간언 홀이 긴 기계 지팡이와 별도 사각 책·패드로 생성됨. 가슴 창과 위쪽 허벅지 개방·복부와 팔의 장갑 유지.
